data.title: 鸣濑白羽 · 夏夜神社祭典的特制炒饭
data.description: 鸣濑神社夏日祭典红灯笼高挂的夜市前，白羽系着白色围裙在铁板灶台前专注翻炒金黄炒饭，锅气蒸腾，小脸被炉火映得微红，认真得令人莞尔。
data.location: night festival food stall courtyard beneath strung red paper lanterns and maple trees
data.action: standing behind iron teppan griddle holding cooking spatula, stirring steaming fried rice with serious focused gaze and rosy cheeks
data.lighting: 铁板灶火与上方红纸灯笼红晕
data.promptProse: Shiroha in an apron over her uniform expertly works a festival griddle, tossing steaming fried rice under strings of warm red lanterns.
data.animaCaption: Lantern light and food steam drift around her serious expression as she tends the festival griddle.
